title: feat(pm/fleet-write): three security-advisory relay rows, payload read from the event file
body:
domain:skills#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnMUWA9rufXzFaEh4J

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xXfiM8rhUoVNhMiyhTUMGmM)_

Fixes #29160

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 中继新增三行:`advisory_report` 提交报告、`advisory_collaborators_add` 加协作者、`advisory_state` 只能改成 draft 或 closed。
- `published` 没有任何一行能到达,按名拒收;发布仍由维护者手动完成。
- 三行各自单独成笔,只有这三种笔的令牌带 `repository-advisories: write`;⛔ 没有回退到未收窄令牌的路径。
- 工作流的每个步骤都不再把 `client_payload` 放进 `env:`,两个脚本改从事件文件读载荷。
- 摘要、描述与漏洞文本不进任何日志行、结果行、步骤摘要或注解;标记测试经消融证明会变红。
- 令牌已实测(run 41415522766);只有合并后首次真跑才能定的几项,列在 Acceptance notes。

## What changes

- **`scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`.** Three new rows, each `alone`, each spending `repository-advisories: write`, a grant minted for its stroke only (`STROKE_SCOPED_PERMISSIONS`):
  - `advisory_report`: one `POST .../security-advisories/reports`. Required `summary` and `description`, optional `severity` and `cwe_ids`.
  - `advisory_collaborators_add`: `ghsa_id` and `collaborators`.
  - `advisory_state`: `ghsa_id` and `advisory_state`, an enum of `draft` and `closed` only. `published` is refused by name (`ADVISORY_REFUSED_STATES`).
  - `REFUSED_PATH_FAMILIES` refuses every `security-advisories` path except one advisory's path and the reports endpoint, so no row reaches a draft create, a text edit, a collaborator removal, a CVE request or a temporary fork.
  - New `quiet` field modifier: a refusal names the key and the byte count and never echoes the value. `summary` and `description` are `str` fields, which never echo either.
  - The header records the measured mint, the list of what only the live run decides, and the sender-gate ruling beside the rows.
- **`.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml`.** No step's `env:` carries `client_payload` or `FLEET_WRITE_PAYLOAD` any more. The validate step runs `validate.mjs --from-event --github-output`, and the execute step reads the event file itself. The mint gains the scoped `permission-repository-advisories` input, with a comment that the action's "Unexpected input(s)" warning is expected and must not be "fixed" by removing the input.
- **`scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs`.** `readEventPayload` reads `client_payload` from `$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH` for every op, and its refusals never quote the file. Field kinds, the enums, the `quiet` and `named` refusals, fixtures and two new batteries (the event file, 6 cases; the advisory rows, 44 cases). Battery floor 15.
- **`scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs`.** The three paths of the card's Change §4:
  - collaborators: GET; the advisory must be the one named and in `triage` or `draft`; logins compared case-insensitively; nothing missing sends nothing; otherwise one PATCH of the existing logins plus the missing ones; landed only when the answer lists every login.
  - state: GET; `draft` only from `triage`, `closed` only from `triage` or `draft`; an illegal move sends nothing; landed only when the answer shows the state.
  - report: landed on a 2xx carrying a `ghsa_id`; the id goes in the row and in a notice annotation. A 2xx with no id is a failed action that says ⛔ do not re-send.
  - Rows, logs, the step summary and annotations carry the id, the state and logins only. A platform message is quoted only when it is on the known list (`ADVISORY_PLATFORM_MESSAGES`).
  - New battery (22 cases), floor 21.
- **`scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`.** The seat reads the report's id from the run's annotations (`--json` gains `advisories`). A note where the read-back is decided says why byte read-back cannot apply to `advisory_report`: the report carries no body the relay can read back. New seat battery (12 cases), floor 26 (25 → 26 after the merge of `main`, which carries #29225's battery at 25).
- **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md`.** One line naming the three ops.
- **`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`.** The rest-channel row goes from 80 to 81, by the measured delta of +1 line, and nothing else in the file changes. The comment beside the row cites the ruling of record: card #29160's body, which quotes the maintainer verbatim (「可以，按方案改中继，能发这个操作的账号名单我稍后点名。」 and 「你写清楚issue就可以，让车道开发」), and the seat's comment 6572738609, which stated the raise.

## Why

The fleet has to file a private security report, add the people who work it and move its state without the maintainer's hand, and the relay's run log and step summary are public. The old route put `client_payload` in step `env:`, which GitHub prints into the log, so report text would have reached the log. This change moves the payload to the event file for every op, adds the three rows, and keeps every advisory field but the id, the state and the logins off every public surface.

## Tests

All three self-tests pass with the new batteries counted:

- `pnpm check:pm-fleet-write-validate`: 268 cases pass across 15 batteries.
- `pnpm check:pm-fleet-write-execute`: 232 cases pass across 21 batteries.
- `pnpm check:pm-fleet-write-dispatch`: 296 cases pass across 26 batteries (277 across 25 at 56f05337; the merge of `main` brought in #29225's pull request body battery, 19 cases).

The card's Acceptance list, item by item:

- A malformed `ghsa_id` is refused before any request: validator advisory battery, and the executor's validator-gate case (zero requests).
- A stroke with another action beside these rows is refused: validator and seat batteries.
- Only these strokes' tokens carry the grant: validator battery (the scoped mint output is `write` for these strokes and empty for every other).
- Existing collaborators survive, and an all-present list sends no PATCH: executor battery.
- Each illegal transition sends no PATCH, and `published` is refused by name: validator and executor batteries.
- An answer that does not show the result fails the action: executor battery, for all three rows.
- No `env:` carries `client_payload`: the validator's event-file battery reads the workflow, with a positive control showing the check finds a planted line.
- ⛔ The marker test: a marker placed in a report's `summary` and `description`, and in every advisory answer's `summary`, `description` and `vulnerabilities`, appears in no log line, row, step summary, annotation or pace log across 32 executor runs, nor in the output of real `validate.mjs` and `execute.mjs` processes reading an event file that carries it. A positive control shows the generic row printer would print it.

## Acceptance notes

- **The mint is measured** (run 41415522766, recorded in the card's body): the narrowed mint succeeds, and the grant is what opens an advisory's read and its PATCH (200 with it, 403 without). The action's "Unexpected input(s) 'permission-repository-advisories'" warning is expected.
- **Only the first live run after merge decides:**
  - a valid report filed by the App, and whom the platform records as its reporter;
  - a real account added as a collaborator, and whether the PATCH replaces the list or merges it (the executor sends existing plus missing, so either holds);
  - the two transitions (`triage` to `draft`, and to `closed`) made by the App;
  - whether a report needs the grant at all (both tokens reached the reports endpoint's 422 in the measurement).
  - A refusal on any of these is a failed action carrying the remedy text. ⛔ It is never retried under a wider or un-narrowed token; the reading goes to the maintainer.
- **The sender gate does not change.** The maintainer's ruling, recorded beside the rows in `ops.mjs`: 「所有车队账户都能发这个操作」. What it admits: any fleet account with write on the target can add itself to an advisory whose id it holds.
- The live advisory run was not made from this branch.

## Verification

- **Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 62 commands for the 7 paths. All 62 ran with each exit code captured before any pipe, and every one exited 0. `--ran` reconciled them: 62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 because its packages were not built; after `turbo run build` of `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` it exited 0.
  - That full run was on the branch before its rebase onto `main` at 14208f2c. The branch then merged `main` at 9f120af9 (merge commit bdb323da). The only conflict was the battery-floor comment in `dispatch.mjs`, resolved by keeping both batteries and setting `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` to 26. The ratchet file auto-merged, and `execute.mjs`, `validate.mjs`, `ops.mjs`, `fleet-write.yml` and `rest-channel.md` are blob-identical to 56f05337. At bdb323da the dev and the seat's delta review each re-ran the three self-tests (268/15, 232/21, 296/26), and the review also re-ran `check:pm-skill-ratchet` and its `--self-test`; all exit 0. The 19 commits it brought in touch none of the 7 paths except one non-overlapping row in the ratchet file. At the rebased head the derivation names the same 62 commands, and these 13 were run again, all exit 0: `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-fleet-write-validate`, `check:pm-fleet-write-execute`, `check:pm-fleet-write-dispatch`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:workflow-step-name-quoting`, `check:workflow-status-functions`, `check:watch-hint-literal`, `check:scripts-symbol-anchors`, `check:declared-population-live` and `check-self-test-wired.mjs`.
  - Not measured locally: CI's type-check lanes, the shard attestations and the path-scheduled Plan Test Core step. No TypeScript changed, and CI runs them on this PR.
- **Ablations**, at 56f05337, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which restores the file and confirms an empty `git diff HEAD`:
  - **A.** The report's landed row also prints the answer's `summary` (`execute.mjs`, blob 556168a36234). The marker test and the row-shape case go red: 2 of 232 fail.
  - **B.** A refused answer quotes any platform message, known or not (`execute.mjs`). The marker test and two refusal cases go red: 3 of 232 fail.
  - **C.** A quiet enum echoes the value it refuses (`validate.mjs`, blob 134579ec575b). The marker-in-the-wrong-key case goes red: 1 of 268 fails.
  - **D.** The validate step gets back an `env:` carrying `client_payload` (`fleet-write.yml`, blob 8e31d25de5d7). Both event-file pins go red: 2 of 268 fail.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the five changed scripts exits 0. The workspace-wide `pnpm lint` was not run.
- No changeset: the diff touches only `scripts/pm`, a workflow and a skill reference, none of which publishes, so the PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (Not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint over the changed files passes (see Verification).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. Nothing publishes, so no changeset; both declaration lines are filled in.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English, except the 维护者速读 section and the verbatim rulings, which the lane asks for in Chinese.
- [ ] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. (Left unchecked: the workspace-wide `pnpm lint` was not run; eslint over the changed files was.)
